title: Analyzer
description: Top-level definition for a doctype analyzer. v2 shape — no per-field extraction directives. Declares the fact categories the analyzer enables and the role taxonomy used during categorisation. Goes in configs/analyzers/<doctype>/analyzer.yaml.

id.description: Stable identifier. Folder name MUST match. Leading underscore is reserved for inheritable base analyzers (e.g. _universal).

version.description: Semver-ish version. Bump to invalidate downstream caches.

extends.description: Another analyzer id whose categories + roles are merged in first. Typically '_universal'.

classify_when.description: Rules step 4a (outline) uses to nominate this analyzer based on the LLM doctype guess and document title.

categories.description: Fact categories this analyzer enables. The step 4c (categorise) call constrains the LLM's category choice to this list. OPEN vocabulary: a domain declares the categories it needs. The binding check is not this schema but test_ontology_compile.py::test_analyzer_categories_match_their_ontology, which requires every analyzer's categories to match its ontology's declared extraction categories EXACTLY, for every shipped doctype. That catches typos and orphans far better than a closed list, and it does not force every future domain into the first domain's vocabulary.

roles.description: Per-category role taxonomy. Step 4c assigns one role per fact when it matches a defined role for that category. role=null otherwise.

confidence_thresholds.description: Override pipeline.yaml load.confidence defaults for this doctype.

notes.description: Free-form note for maintainers. Ignored by the loader.
